usage: Level-up spell list for the listed classes. Combat runs it only when a wired ability has the same id.

srd.text:
_Level 1 Transmutation (Bard, Druid, Ranger, Wizard)_

**Casting Time:** Action
**Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
**Duration:** 1 hour

You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

_Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot._ You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
